create_asyncnode_instance: create an AsyncNode instance with a node ID and optional chunk store and node map
put_object_into_node: put an object into the AsyncNode chunk store with an optional sequence ID and mimetype
read_next_chunk_async: read the next chunk from the AsyncNode asynchronously with an optional timeout value
consume_single_item: consume exactly one item from the AsyncNode and raise an error if the node is empty or has multiple items
iterate_node_chunks: iterate over AsyncNode chunks using async for loop with automatic deserialization support
